Do not state your guesses as policy. If nothing is missing, set needed to false. Use a short, verbatim source substring as quote. Look for an uncovered input or a change of state. Ask what result the owner wants in that situation. The previous owner replies in this request are authoritative alongside the public request. Ask only when two different rules still fit both.
